Name: Volume+
Description: A volume dial, a microphone control, a clock, and a timer for your Stream Deck touch display, each showing Caps Lock, Game Mode, and wireless headset battery status badges. A Volume Controller replacement for keyboards with a built-in Stream Deck, like the Corsair Galleon 100 SD, where the Caps Lock light is gone. Single-color theming and ten clock faces, including flip-clock, 7-segment, 14-segment, and dot-matrix LED styles. Windows only.
